## Problem and resulting behavior

Task ID and scope. Describe the concrete trigger and behavior after this change.

## Acceptance evidence

Map observable task criteria to tests or reproducible observations. Include
commands, environment, actual results, and artifact paths. Explicitly label
failed and unrun checks with reasons; fixture results do not prove private-estate
or native macOS first-run readiness.

## Contracts and review

Explain public-contract/migration decisions and relevant IR, generation,
provenance, result-state, source non-mutation, MCP read-only, and browser-security
checks. State any remaining limitations. Confirm the final diff was inspected.

## Persistent handoff

Link `.codex/plans/<task>.md`, branch/commit, blockers and resume instructions.
Set queue status to awaiting_review; do not mark merged until a merge/squash
commit is verified on origin/main. No automatic merge or next-task launch.
